"Game Overview: Diaper Roulette
​Genre: Social Party / Multiplayer Survival / Strategy
​Player Count: 20 Players per match
​Core Loop: Random role assignment, high-stakes time-management tasks, psychological pressure, and cooperative/competitive survival mechanics.
​Phase 1: The Draft @COMMENT_BODY@ Randomization
​At the start of every match, the system randomly assigns all 20 players into two distinct factions:
​The Wearers (10 Players): Your primary goal is survival, mobility management, and task completion. You are paired with a specific diaper companion for the duration of the match.
​The Diapers (10 Players): Your goal is to survive the match while bound to a Wearer, endure the modifications, and help (or hinder) your Wearer depending on your playstyle.
​Phase 2: The Modification Stage
​Once pairings are locked in, the game enters a chaotic 60-second modification phase. Exactly 5 random modifications are applied to the Diapers from a randomized pool, altering gameplay physics, comfort, and capacity:
​High-Capacity Padding: Massively increases fluid absorption limits, but severely reduces the Wearer's movement speed and agility.
​Crinkly Lining: Generates audible noise with every step, making it impossible for the Wearer to sneak past hazards or other players.
​Thermal Lock: Increases internal temperature rapidly when the Wearer moves fast, accelerating the need to use facilities.
​Snug Compression: Locks the diaper tightly in place, preventing accidental slips but increasing discomfort penalties if tasks are delayed.
​Sensitive Sensors: Imparts direct sensory feedback to the Diaper player based on the Wearer’s actions, heightening immersion and stakes.
​Phase 3: The Task Marathon
​Each Wearer receives a completely unique randomized list of 20 distinct tasks scattered across the map (e.g., repairing machinery, gathering rare items, navigating obstacle courses).
​The Catch: Movement speed, stamina, and agility are directly impacted by your assigned Diaper and its active modifications.
​The Soiling Mechanic: As tasks drag on and the Thermal Lock or physical exertion builds up, Wearers face a strict biological meter. If a Wearer fails to reach a designated rest zone or completes tasks too slowly while their meter maxes out, they must soil their diaper. Doing so adds a massive mobility debuff and a temporary point penalty, turning a simple task run into a desperate scramble.
​Phase 4: Victory and the Ultimate Penalty
​Standard Win: The first 9 Wearers to successfully complete all 20 tasks and safely remove/revert their diaper companions win the match and secure safety.
​The Final Fate: The last remaining Wearer who fails to complete their tasks in time faces the ultimate consequence—they are permanently transformed into a diaper, which is then claimed and worn by the match's ultimate winner.
​Key Gameplay Features for Development
​Dynamic Physics Engine: Realistic shifting, weight distribution, and sound design based on the chosen modifications.
​Asymmetrical Communication: Proximity chat allows Wearers and Diapers to strategize, panic, or negotiate in real-time.
​Customization @COMMENT_BODY@ Cosmetics: Unlockable patterns, fluff types, and badges for both furry avatars and their gear.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
